messages:
sara: Hey team — seeing a spike of websocket resume failures in eu-west around 08:09-08:15 UTC. Clients reconnect, then resume returns 410 or 403 intermittently. When resume fails clients open a fresh stream and we end up with duplicate billing tokens. Anyone seen this?

jordan: I noticed a similar blip in prod-2 at the same time. Console shows reconnects up, but resume_success_count doesn't jump. Logs show missing Last-Event-ID on some proxy requests.

patrick: Could be related to the token namespace swap from the rotation earlier. Did we flip any resume-related proxy flags in that canary?

lee: We did flip a canary around 08:05 in eu-west1: `resume_strip_namespace=true` for the proxy sidecar. Canary rollout was small but overlapped the window. @sara does the timeline line up exactly? :thinking: 

sara: Yes timeline lines up. Repro-ish snippet (client side):
```
> wscat -c "wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1/stream" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Last-Event-ID: evt_12345:ns:abcd'
# client reconnects, server responds 410 sometimes
```
And proxy log excerpt:
```
[08:09:12] proxy-eu-2 GET /v1/stream - headers: {Authorization, Host} - last_event_id: null - action: resume_attempt
[08:09:13] auth service: token namespace mapped to ns:abcd -> rotated -> new ns:efgh
[08:09:14] proxy-eu-2 resume_result: 410 - reason: namespace_mismatch
```

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout 2026-03-15T08:05:00Z -> eu-west1 (12%) ; flag `resume_strip_namespace` set to true for canary.

jordan: Console UX / telemetry note: our streaming dashboard measures `socket_open` and `resume_ack` separately. If proxy strips last_event_id we only see socket_open spikes, not resume failures. That makes root cause hard to spot. Can telemetry add a `resume_received` tag at proxy ingress?

patrick: Two-pronged suggestion: (1) revert the canary flag in eu-west until we have telemetry, (2) add a lightweight `resume_debug` field in proxy logs that echoes the incoming Last-Event-ID (masked) and the token namespace we resolved. That should help dashboard correlation without changing resume semantics.

lee: Agreed — telemetry-first. API change (return codes) is heavier. If we return 409 instead of 410 for namespace mismatch we risk clients treating it differently. Better to enrich logs/metrics first and let console show overlay of rollout%.

sara: I'll do the rollback now for eu-west1 canary and open a follow-up PR to add the `resume_debug` probe. Action items: revert flag in k8s (done?), add console panel that overlays canary % vs resume_result, PR #1234 to add masked last_event_id in logs, and ping oncall to watch.

patrick: quick note — when adding logs please ensure we sample (1%) to avoid carding logs for high-volume tenants. Use trace_id correlation so console can join socket_open -> resume_attempt -> resume_result.

sara: Good call, will sample and add trace id. Oncall notified.

lee: Thanks — once telemetry lands we can consider a small API tweak if clients need a clearer response. For now, rollback + probe should give enough signal. :thumbsup:

sara: Summary: rollback canary in eu-west (done), add resume_debug probe (PR opened), add dashboard overlay. Follow-up postmortem if we see recurrence.
